statements.t: The Company increased its target for revenue to $5.790 billion to $5.830 billion
The Company increased its target for Adjusted EBITDA to $2.295 billion to $2.315 billion

“As we close out what we’ve called our year of execution, our decision to raise full-year guidance for the second time this year is the clearest expression of our conviction across the entire portfolio.
In February, the Company issued revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $5.675 billion to $5.775 billion and $2.240 billion to $2.290 billion, respectively, for the full year 2026.
In August, the Company raised its revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $5.775 billion to $5.825 billion and $2.275 billion to $2.305 billion, respectively, for the full year 2026.

Based on performance through the first nine months of the year and our visibility into and anticipated performance for the remainder of the year, the Company is raising its guidance and now expects full year 2026 revenue of $5.790 billion to $5.830 billion and Adjusted EBITDA of $2.295 billion to $2.315 billion.
The anticipated performance assumes that the Company stages all live events, including those in the Middle East region, as currently planned.
The Company intends to provide additional detail related to its 2026 guidance on today’s earnings call.
The Company announced that it intends to commence additional repurchases of its outstanding Class A common stock under its existing share repurchase program.
The Company expects to repurchase the balance of the existing authorization, which it intends to fund primarily from additional debt and cash on hand.

Reconciliations of the Company’s Non-GAAP financial measure guidance to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures cannot be provided without unreasonable efforts and are not provided herein because of the inherent difficulty in forecasting and quantifying certain amounts that are necessary for such reconciliations and certain other items reflected in our reconciliation of historical Non-GAAP financial…
All interested parties are welcome to listen to a live webcast that will be hosted through the Company’s website at investor.tkogrp.com .
A replay of the call will be available approximately two hours after the conference call concludes and can be accessed on the Company’s website.
